name: Smart Date Parser
description: Parses text fields holding dates in mixed formats (ISO, day-first or month-first, named months, compact, with time zones) into Date fields, and flags the values it could not read.
introductoryText:
Turns text fields holding dates in mixed or unknown formats into Date fields, one value at a time, so a field where one supplier writes `04/03/2025` and another `2025-03-04T09:30:00Z` ends up with one Date type.

**How to set it up**: choose the fields to parse. Tick **Day first** when ambiguous dates such as `04/03/2025` mean 4 March (UK and European style); leave it unticked for 3 April (US style). Values that start with a four-digit year are always read year-month-day.

Each parsed field is written next to the original, named with the **Output suffix** (`Order Date` becomes `Order Date_parsed`); with an empty suffix the field is replaced. A `_failed` field (true/false) marks the values that were not empty but could not be read, such as `31/02/2025` or `March 2025` (a value must hold a year, a month and a day).

**Custom formats** are Python `strptime` codes, comma-separated (for example `%y%m%d` for `250307`); they are tried first. Values with a time zone or offset (`Z`, `+01:00`) are converted to UTC; values without one are kept as they are.

options.name: fields_to_parse
options.title: Fields to parse
options.description: Text fields holding dates. Fields that are already Date fields are copied unchanged.

options.name: output_suffix
options.title: Output suffix
options.description: Added to each field name for the parsed field (Order Date becomes Order Date_parsed). Leave empty to replace the field in place.

options.name: prefer_day_first
options.title: Day first
options.description: Read ambiguous dates such as 04/03/2025 as day/month (4 March). Unticked, they are read month/day (3 April). Dates starting with a four-digit year are always year-month-day.

options.name: add_failure_flag
options.title: Add failure flag
options.description: Add a field ending in _failed that is true where a value was present but could not be read.

options.name: keep_original_fields
options.title: Keep original fields
options.description: Keep the original text fields next to the parsed ones. Only applies when there is an output suffix.

options.name: custom_formats
options.title: Custom formats
options.description: Optional. Python strptime codes, comma-separated, tried before the built-in formats; for example %y%m%d,%d.%m.%Y

blockOutputs.label: Parsed
blockOutputs.tooltip: The input with a Date field (and a _failed flag) for each parsed field.
